summary: The PR addresses an issue with the `kind` attribute of the `Derivative` class but introduces some concerns regarding maintainability and test coverage.

issues.description: The PR does not include any new tests to verify the functionality of the added `kind` property for `Derivative`. This is crucial to ensure that the fix works as intended and to prevent future regressions.
The import statement for `UndefinedKind` is placed inside the class definition, which is unconventional and can lead to confusion. It should be moved to the top of the file with other imports.
